meta.title: Carrier Packet
meta.description: Operating authority, W-9 and certificate of insurance for KUL Enterprises, USDOT {usdot}, MC {mc}. Authority and insurance can be checked on the federal record without asking us.

start.heading: The packet comes by email.
start.body: Ask here and the documents come back by email, usually the same business day. The authority and the insurance filing are on the federal record below if you would rather check them yourself.

documents.name: Operating authority
documents.note: KUL's own, and already public. It is set out on the federal record below.

documents.name: W-9
documents.note: KUL's own, completed and signed for KUL Enterprises LLC.

documents.name: Certificate of insurance
documents.note: Issued by KUL's insurance agent rather than by KUL. Your company is named as holder on request, which the agent has to do.

documents.name: Carrier or broker agreement
documents.note: KUL signs your paper rather than sending its own. Send the agreement with the packet request and it comes back executed.

record.heading: On the federal record
record.note: Both of these are the government's own lookups, not ours. Neither needs an account and neither tells us you looked.

links.label: Check the authority on FMCSA SAFER

request.heading: Ask for the packet
request.footnote: Already set up and just need a price? [Send the lane](/quote). Or call {phone}.
